recipes.name: Grilled Cheese
recipes.desc: Three cheese squares melted between two buttery toasted slices. Simple, golden and emotionally supportive.
steps: Butter the outsides with ING_BUTTER and grill the ING_BREAD_SLICE sandwich so the ING_CHEESE melts; flip once.
Plate the halves leaning on each other.
cx: The cheese didn't ooze. A grilled cheese must OOZE.
You cut it in rectangles. I'm not a monster.
recipes.look: Two golden-brown triangles with a thick yellow cheese ooze leaning together like friends.
recipes.anim: Cheese stretches between the halves when pulled apart (prop beam).
recipes.vfx: Butter shimmer and a small golden steam puff.
recipes.mut: `MUT_010` Toaster Head (fire, `ABL_034` is combat only) gives Hot Hands on the grill; customers wearing `MUT_010` order it twice (bark).

recipes.name: Ham & Cheese Sandwich
recipes.desc: Shaved ham, cheese and a mustard zig-zag between square bread. The sandwich that packs its own lunch.
cx: The ham is folded. I wanted it pleated.
Mustard should zig. This zags.
recipes.look: Neat square sandwich halved into triangles, pink ham ruffles peeking out, yellow mustard zig-zag.
recipes.anim: Ham ruffles flutter as the plate lands (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Tiny sparkle on the mustard zig-zag.
recipes.mut: `claw` parts (`MUT_144` Crab Claw Arm) shave the ham in fewer taps (Pincer Prep).

recipes.name: Hot Dog Classic
recipes.desc: A snappy grilled dog in a Long Boi Bun with ketchup, mustard, onion and pickle relish. Barks optional.
steps: Dice ING_ONION and ING_PICKLE into relish.
Grill ING_HOTDOG; roll it over once.
ING_HOTDOG_BUN, ING_HOTDOG, ING_KETCHUP, ING_MUSTARD, ING_ONION, ING_PICKLE.
cx: The hot dog is longer than the bun. Classic betrayal.
Ketchup AND mustard? Pick a side!
recipes.look: Grill-striped hot dog poking out both ends of the bun, red and yellow zig-zags, green relish confetti.
recipes.anim: Hot dog does a tiny 'snap' wiggle on the first ANM_043 bite.
recipes.mut: `MUT_003` Dog Head customers find it 'awkward' (bark); `MUT_212` Dog Tail wags faster near it (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Club Sandwich Stack
recipes.desc: Three toasted slices, turkey, crispy bacon, lettuce and tomato, quartered and speared with toothpicks. Members only (members = anyone with 19 MB).
steps: Fold-slice ING_TURKEY; shred ING_LETTUCE; slice ING_TOMATO.
ING_BREAD_SLICE, ING_MAYO, ING_TURKEY, ING_LETTUCE, ING_BREAD_SLICE, ING_BACON, ING_TOMATO, ING_BREAD_SLICE.
Spear each quarter with a frilly toothpick.
cx: The toothpick frill is beige. I asked for CELEBRATION.
Three slices of bread and you couldn't find a fourth?
recipes.look: Four tall triangle quarters with visible double-decker layers and frilly toothpicks.
recipes.anim: Quarters fan out on the plate in a 4-step tween when plated.
recipes.vfx: Toothpick frills sparkle; crumb puff on cut.
recipes.mut: `ABL_061` Extra Hands lets you toast and fry at once; Many Hands builds the double-decker in fewer inputs.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter & Jellyfish
recipes.desc: Peanut butter and chopped jellyfish gummies on soft bread. It's the classic PB&J, if J stood for 'jiggles and has tendrils'.
steps: Chop three ING_JELLYFISH_GUMMY into wobbly pieces.
Cut the crusts off (4 taps) — non-negotiable.
Plate it with one gummy tendril dangling out.
cx: The jellyfish is NOT jiggling. Did you upset it?
Crusts. I see CRUSTS.
recipes.look: Crustless square sandwich with translucent pink jelly tendrils peeking out the sides.
recipes.anim: Gummy tendrils wiggle when the plate is bumped (prop bones).
recipes.mut: `MUT_130` Jellyfish Body customers react with an offended gasp (bark, no anger); tentacle parts stack in one input.

recipes.name: Chili Dog Disaster
recipes.desc: A hot dog buried under chili, cheese sauce, onion and jalapeño until it becomes a delicious structural failure. Napkins sold separately (they're free).
steps: Warm ING_CHEESE_SAUCE on the second burner.
ING_HOTDOG_BUN, ING_HOTDOG, ING_CHILI landslide, ING_CHEESE_SAUCE, ING_ONION, ING_JALAPENO.
Plate in a boat with a fork stuck in it (you'll need it).
cx: It's not a disaster, it's a mild inconvenience.
I can SEE the hot dog. Bury it deeper.
recipes.look: Hot dog boat overflowing with red-brown chili and orange cheese sauce, the dog barely visible.
recipes.anim: Chili slops over the boat edge when plated (texture-scroll drip); customer uses fork prop.
recipes.vfx: Comic 'SPLORT' text and sauce-splat decals on the tray (cosmetic only, never on the floor).
recipes.mut: `sticky` parts (`MUT_170` Sticky Gecko Hands) carry the overloaded boat without drips (Sticky Grip applies to this dish as a bonus); Steam Team speeds both pots.

recipes.name: BLT (Bacon Lettuce Tentacle)
recipes.desc: Bacon, lettuce and a grilled squishy tentacle on toast. Every time someone asks 'where's the tomato?' the tentacle waves.
steps: Grill ING_TENTACLE; flip as it curls.
ING_BREAD_SLICE, ING_MAYO, ING_LETTUCE, ING_BACON, ING_TENTACLE, ING_BREAD_SLICE.
Plate with the tentacle tip waving out the side.
cx: Where's the tomato? ...Oh. OH.
The tentacle waved at my date.
recipes.look: Toasted sandwich with crispy bacon and a purple tentacle tip curling out one side.
recipes.anim: Tentacle tip waves twice when the customer reads it (prop bones).
recipes.vfx: Small bubble pops from the tentacle.
recipes.mut: Tentacle parts get a 'cousin' bark; Sea Legs on the tentacle grill; `MUT_029` Octopus Head chefs grill it with feeling (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Sandwich With Bread in the Middle
recipes.desc: Lettuce on the outside, toast in the middle, fillings everywhere else. The sandwich turned inside-out and then sideways.
steps: Toast the single ING_BREAD_SLICE; flip once.
Fold ING_HAM and ING_TURKEY; slice ING_TOMATO and ING_PICKLE.
ING_LETTUCE leaf, ING_MAYO, ING_HAM, ING_CHEESE, ING_BACON, ING_BREAD_SLICE in the middle, ING_TURKEY, ING_CHEESE, ING_TOMATO, ING_PICKLE, ING_LETTUCE leaf.
Plate it and refuse to explain.
cx: The bread is slightly off-centre. The MIDDLE, I said.
Where is the outside bread? Oh. It's lettuce. Hmm.
recipes.look: Tall stack wrapped top and bottom in big lettuce leaves with a single golden toast slice right in the middle.
recipes.anim: Customer peeks into the side of the stack (head tilt) before ANM_043.
recipes.mut: `MUT_028`... customers with `MUT_073` Fly Compound Eyes see 'all the breads' (bark); Many Hands handles the 11-layer stack.

recipes.name: Sub of Unreasonable Length
recipes.desc: A Ten-Foot Baguette (actually six studs) loaded end-to-end with ham, turkey, pepperoni, cheese and salad. It hangs off the tray, the table and the laws of portion control.
steps: Warm ING_MEGA_BAGUETTE on MED (it sticks out of the door).
Shred ING_LETTUCE; slice ING_TOMATO and ING_ONION.
ING_MEGA_BAGUETTE base, ING_MAYO, ING_LETTUCE, ING_HAM, ING_TURKEY, ING_PEPPERONI, ING_CHEESE, ING_TOMATO, ING_ONION, ING_MEGA_BAGUETTE lid.
Plate on the long tray; it overhangs by 2 studs.
cx: It's only Somewhat Unreasonable.
I need a second table for the other end.
recipes.look: A 6-stud sub on a long tray with fillings visible along its whole length and toothpick flags every stud.
recipes.anim: Two customers can eat from opposite ends (party ANM_043 sync); the carrier uses ANM_007 with a balancing wobble.
recipes.vfx: Comic measuring-tape decal flashes '6 STUDS!' on serve.
recipes.mut: `MUT_110` Giraffe Neck and `MUT_114` Brachiosaurus Neck (tall) chefs reach both ends without walking (bark); carry-boost parts carry it one-handed.

recipes.name: The Sandwich Sandwich
recipes.desc: A club sandwich, a fancy grilled cheese and a PB&Jellyfish, all stacked between two more slices of bread. It's sandwiches all the way down.
steps: Grill the inner cheese sandwich: two ING_BREAD_SLICE around ING_CHEESE and ING_FANCY_FROMAGE; flip once.
Toast the other four ING_BREAD_SLICE; flip once.
Slice ING_TURKEY and ING_HAM; shred ING_LETTUCE; chop ING_JELLYFISH_GUMMY.
ING_BREAD_SLICE, ING_MAYO, ING_LETTUCE, ING_TURKEY, ING_HAM, ING_BACON, the grilled ING_CHEESE + ING_FANCY_FROMAGE sandwich, ING_PEANUT_BUTTER, ING_JELLYFISH_GUMMY, ING_BREAD_SLICE.
Halve the whole tower (2 taps) to show the cross-section.
Plate cut-side out so everyone can see the sandwiches inside.
cx: I count three sandwiches. The menu implied infinity.
Which sandwich do I bite? All of them? At once?
recipes.look: A towering cross-section showing three distinct sandwich layers (club, grilled cheese, PB&Jellyfish) between outer toast.
recipes.anim: Cross-section slides apart like a book on the plate (prop tween).
recipes.mut: `ABL_061` Extra Hands grills and fries together; Haunted Toaster customers (`PER_028`) salute it (bark).
